Define the assistant persona and boundaries (blank = model default)…
Download the model, then chat runs entirely on this device
First setup needs a one-time network download (~1.5-2.6 GB) from Hugging Face — no account required. Uncensored, reasoning and standard models all live in one menu.
After download, inference is 100% offline — prompts and outputs never leave the device.

No content filter exists in local inference — the model behaves exactly as its weights dictate. Other uncensored models (TinyDolphin-1.1B, abliterated Qwen2.5-1.5B / Llama-3.2-1B safetensors) can be converted to .litertlm on a PC with litert-torch and pulled in via import or URL download.
Runtime supports arm64-v8a / x86_64 only; ~6 GB RAM recommended. On weaker devices the model loads slowly or fails.
1.5B-parameter quantized models: fast and private, but not cloud-scale assistants. Treat their output accordingly.
This device\'s CPU is not supported by the LiteRT-LM runtime (arm64 / x86_64 only).
Device memory is below the model\'s 6 GB recommendation — loading may fail.
One-click download + auto setup, zero configuration. Every model in the menu downloads straight from Hugging Face and loads automatically.
